task/solution/app/server.js lines 95-116 (restore operation_id dedupe stored in SQLite restore_operations)
git show 5e036ba0 (judge.toml and instructions diffs); frozen judge.toml/ui.md/behaviour.md sha256 equal to projects/colderwater-playground-devtools working copy
evidence: All 54 criteria (render 1, constraints 2, functional 43, polish 6, visual 3 likert with 0-5 anchors) name a concrete browser outcome with a durable read-back: re-read editor source, copied selection, readout, console/preview markers, revision lists after fresh page/storage clear/restart_app, visible notices, computed styles or screenshots. No criterion relies on source reading, a response-shape assertion without a state change, or a traceless probe: cw_restore_request_repeat_safe notes the reply status but grades the revision count on a freshly loaded page; cw_preview_isolation requires every probe to log a line, silent probes repeated once then failed, and a resolved no-cors fetch counts as reaching the network; cw_dynamic_code_refused builds payload markers from two halves so they never appear in source. Probes are distinctive and judge-chosen. Row-32 pattern (Stop/newer-run race with undefined repeats) checked task-wide: all four race criteria now define one Playwright code-runner action, an observable void condition and 'up to two more' attempts, failing only if every attempt is void: cw_output_before_failure_kept, cw_last_good_recovery, cw_stop_cancels_pending_work, cw_newer_run_supersedes (functional/judge.toml lines 289, 325, 343, 352). For cw_newer_run_supersedes the void case can be told apart afterwards by console order (old before new = void; new then old = broken) or by a cleared console. No other criterion has a sub-second race: 3s pause, 8s and 10s waits, about-ten-second limits. Row 25 task-wide: the only addresses are localhost:3000 and 127.0.0.1:3000. app_context.md:27 says no criterion needs an outside address, and no public site appears in any prompt, criterion or note. Row 35: cw_save_reload_restart now builds rev1, rev2 and a restored rev3, re-reads current revision, fields and revision list, and rev1 source after restart_app, then replays the recorded restore. The golden persists operation_id in SQLite (server.js:102-115), so it is feasible. Row 1: overview, policy, security and integration are now in the requester's voice; the diff preserves every requirement. Nothing got looser: the newer-run retry went from 2 to 3 attempts, but only for void attempts and with the same fail conditions, and the restart criterion is stricter. Residual risks for the owner: (a) cw_stop_cancels_pending_work says 'the attempt is void:' without 'not a failure', unlike the other three, so a judge could apply the prompt's two-attempt fail-fast rule (prompt.md:17) to voids; (b) post-restart replay plus cw_restore_request_repeat_safe both fail an app with no restore dedupe, double-penalising one observable (rows 26/28), and an app with only in-memory dedupe that adds stale restores on top, which cw_history_restore_adds_revision allows, fails restart only for dedupe durability, which behaviour.md implies but does not state; (c) ui.md and behaviour.md were not rewritten and still track criteria nearly item by item (row 1 residual); (d) no raw-evidence-index.json and no full configured judge run on this candidate, so the feasibility and workload of the new restart+restore+replay and the 3-attempt race legs are unmeasured.
suggested_fix: Optional hardening, not a row-32 Fail: add 'not a failure' to the void sentence in cw_stop_cancels_pending_work, matching the other three, and/or state in prompt.md that void attempts do not count toward fail-fast. Consider grading after-restart replay only through cw_restore_request_repeat_safe, or say in behaviour.md that a repeated restore stays safe across restarts. Run a full configured judge pass on this candidate before upload.
